value.name: estate is filed and archived
value.description: The closed estate is registered in the Philadelphia Register of Wills office, assigned a number, and filed away in Asha's binder among other closed estates.
evidence: gister of Wills office in Philadelphia and assigned a number, and a copy of it was placed in the binder Asha kept for closed estates, and the binder was placed on a shelf in her office between two other binders of two other estates
value.location_hint: Register of Wills office in Philadelphia

value.name: Spruce Street house remains occupied
value.description: The house on Spruce Street continues as a lived-in home with Lucia and Rosa still residing there.
evidence: The house on Spruce Street remained a house. Lucia lived in it. Rosa lived on the third floor.

value.name: Daniel resumes Sunday visits
value.description: Daniel begins visiting the house on Sunday afternoons, initially awkwardly and then with more ease.
evidence: Daniel visited, at first awkwardly and then less awkwardly, on Sunday afternoons

value.name: Daniel brings kind girlfriend
value.description: By spring, Daniel brings a woman he is seeing, and Lucia learns she is kind to Rosa.
evidence: and brought, by the spring, a woman he was seeing, who was kind to Rosa, which Lucia reported to Asha over coffee as the single most useful piece of information she had received about her brother in fifteen years.

value.name: Lucia reports useful news to Asha
value.description: Lucia tells Asha over coffee that Daniel's girlfriend is kind to Rosa, treating it as the most useful information she has learned about him in years.
evidence: which Lucia reported to Asha over coffee as the single most useful piece of information she had received about her brother in fifteen years

value.name: property charge is paid down
value.description: The debt on the property is reduced according to Asha's repayment schedule.
evidence: The charge on the property was paid down on the schedule Asha had drafted

value.name: property is paid off early
value.description: In the third year, the property is paid off ahead of schedule after Lucia's New York apartment sells for more than expected and she realizes she does not miss it.
evidence: and then, in the third year, paid off early, because Lucia's apartment in New York had sold for more than she had expected and because she found that she did not, in fact, miss it.

value.name: Lucia keeps letter in bedroom drawer
value.description: Lucia stores the letter she found in her bedroom drawer and rereads it on bad days without showing it to Daniel.
evidence: The letter Lucia had found in the sewing room, the one she had given to Asha and that Asha had given back to her, lived in a drawer in Lucia's bedroom, which had been her mother's bedroom, and Lucia read it, on the bad days, and put it back.
She did not show it to Daniel.

value.name: Lucia accepts letter's purpose
value.description: Lucia recognizes that the letter has already accomplished what it was meant to do and is now just an ordinary piece of paper.
evidence: The letter had done its work in the moment it had been written and again in the moment it had been read, and what it had asked Lucia to do, Lucia had done, and the letter was now simply a piece of paper
